sources.title: Amazon Bedrock now offers Pixtral Large 25.02
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the April 8, 2025 announcement explicitly names Pixtral Large 25.02 and its nominal 124B parameters. It describes the Bedrock rollout and native function calling, but supplies no active count or named 2411-to-2502 update relationship.

sources.title: Pixtral Large (25.02) parameters and inference
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the exact-version inference guide states 124B parameters, 128K context, native function calling and Mistral Research License; examples identify mistral.pixtral-large-2502-v1:0. It does not separately report active parameters or identify 2502 as a fine-tune, post-training update or alias of 2411.

sources.title: Pixtral Large is now available in Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the April 10, 2025 post identifies mistral.pixtral-large-2502-v1:0 and explicitly gives 124B overall, comprising a 123B multimodal decoder and 1B vision encoder. These are supported nominal model counts. The post calls Mistral Large 2 its predecessor but does not establish a 2411-to-2502 update relationship or an active count.

sources.title: Pixtral Large model card
sources.evidence: The card maps to the exact 2502 model ID; it marks image/text input, text output and client-side tools supported. Its Nov 19, 2024 launch date conflicts with the dated April 8, 2025 25.02 rollout and is not adopted as this revision’s first release.

sources.title: Pinned Pixtral Large 24.11 model definition
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the pinned Mistral schema explicitly gives 124 total and 124 active for v24.11, links Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411, and names pixtral-large-2411/latest API identifiers. It contains no 2502 alias or named update relationship; its active convention remains usable for 2411, not automatically for 2502.

sources.title: Pinned model weights table renderer
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the renderer labels Parameters (B) and Active (B), confirming billion-parameter units for the schema. It supplies no version mapping.

sources.title: Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411 model card and weights
sources.evidence: Reopened the official README October 27: Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411 is explicitly a nominal 124B multimodal model built on Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407, with a 123B decoder and 1B vision encoder. The current card contains no 2502 reference or relationship linking that revision to these weights. No weight shards were requested.

sources.title: Official Mistral Hugging Face Pixtral repository inventory
sources.evidence: The author-filtered repository search returned Pixtral-12B-Base-2409, Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411 and Pixtral-12B-2409. It returned no 2502 checkpoint; this bounded search is not proof that 2502 is closed-weight.

sources.title: Mistral official changelog
sources.evidence: The changelog records pixtral-large-2411 on November 18, 2024. The accessed full page contains no pixtral-large-2502 entry, so it does not resolve the first public release of 2502.

sources.title: Pixtral Large legal lifecycle
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the family-level legal page includes subsequent versions but lists only base Pixtral Large dated November 18, 2024. It neither identifies 2502 nor describes an unchanged architecture or training relationship between 2411 and 2502.

sources.title: Initial Models.dev Pixtral Large 2502 base record
sources.evidence: The base record introduced on September 9, 2026 assigns April 8, 2025, open_weights false and reasoning false without an exact-version primary citation. These catalog assertions are leads rather than independent proof.

sources.title: Initial Models.dev Bedrock Pixtral Large 2502 provider record
sources.evidence: The provider record added March 13, 2026 already sets April 8, 2025 and false openness/reasoning, without primary evidence establishing an earlier developer release, exact checkpoint availability or dedicated reasoning-mode absence.

sources.title: Later Mistral Large 3 model card
sources.evidence: Fresh full README check October 27: the later Mistral Large 3 card reports active counts for Large 3 itself but has no Pixtral mention or exact 2502 comparison row.

sources.title: Later Mistral Small 3.1 model card
sources.evidence: Fresh full README check October 27: the later Mistral Small 3.1 card has no Pixtral mention or exact 2502 architecture or active-count disclosure.

sources.title: Pinned official model schema index
sources.evidence: The complete pinned tree and 77 model-schema TypeScript files were searched. Pixtral references resolve to 2409 and 2411 entries; no 2502 row or alias supplies exact total/active comparison data.

sources.title: Current Pixtral Large model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 card explicitly identifies v24.11 and pixtral-large-2411. It does not name 2502 or establish a version relationship that would transfer the 2411 active-count convention.

sources.title: Pixtral Large original release
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 reading: the November 18, 2024 release gives 124B total, a 123B decoder and 1B vision encoder, built on Mistral Large 2. It links the 2411 checkpoint and does not describe a later 2502 update or separately state active parameters.

sources.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report, Table 3
sources.evidence: Fresh full HTML and Table 3 inspected October 27. The explicit Act. Params (LLM+VT) comparison provides component counts for Qwen2.5-VL, Llama3.2, Gemma3 and DeepSeek-VL2, but includes no Pixtral model; it supplies no 2502 active count.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh full HTML comparison check October 27 finds only a bibliography reference to Pixtral 12B, with no Pixtral Large 2502 total/active row or version relationship.

sources.title: InternVL3: Exploring Advanced Training and Test-Time Recipes for Open-Source Multimodal Models
sources.evidence: Fresh full HTML comparison check October 27 finds no Pixtral mention and no exact 2502 active-parameter disclosure.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh full HTML comparison check October 27 finds only the Pixtral 12B reference, with no Pixtral Large 2502 row or active-parameter convention for this revision.

name.note: Exact dated variant name is used by AWS; parentheses are catalog formatting.

developer.note: AWS explicitly attributes the model to Mistral AI; retain the existing normalized developer label.

family.note: Pixtral Large is identified as a Mistral model family; retain the normalized pixtral family key.

release_date.note: April 8, 2025 is explicitly the Bedrock rollout; a first public release of exact 2502 is not established. Mistral dates 2411/base to November 18, 2024, while AWS currently lists November 19, 2024. Neither family date nor the 2502 suffix proves a 2502 release day or month. Clear the catalog assertion pending exact release evidence.

open_weights.note: AWS’s MRL statement establishes a license classification, not downloadable 2502 weights. The official schema and repository inventory identify 2411 weights only. No exact equivalence or explicit closed-weight statement was found; clear false rather than infer either answer from the sibling.

license.note: The exact 25.02 inference page explicitly names Mistral Research License. This classification does not establish 2502 checkpoint distribution; hosted-service terms are a separate matter.

parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-25.02 AWS evidence confirms a nominal 124B multimodal total: 123B decoder plus 1B vision encoder. Retain the published precision; an exact tensor census is unnecessary.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh AWS and Mistral sources and later Kimi-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL3 and Qwen3-VL comparisons provide no exact-2502 active count. Mistral explicitly publishes 124B active for 2411, but no named 2411-to-2502 fine-tuning, post-training or alias relationship was found to support a labeled lineage inference. Matching nominal totals alone do not establish that convention for this revision.

architecture.note: AWS establishes a multimodal decoder plus vision encoder, but no exact-2502 primary configuration or technical/interpretability report establishing the catalog’s dense/MoE architecture was found. 2411 architecture cannot be transferred without version equivalence.

context_window.note: AWS explicitly specifies 128,000 tokens for the exact 2502 endpoint. This is the documented provider limit; no native 2502 checkpoint limit is established. Do not replace it with 2411 configuration’s 131,072.

modalities.note: Exact-ID AWS modality table supports text and image input and text output; no audio or video input/output is marked supported.

reasoning.note: Generic mathematical/visual reasoning claims do not establish a dedicated reasoning mode. Exact AWS API examples and capabilities do not explicitly classify such a mode positively or negatively; Models.dev false is unsupported by a primary negative statement. Clear false.

tool_call.note: Exact-version announcement states native function calling; the inference guide supplies 2502 tool-call examples, and the exact-ID card marks client-side tool calling supported.

description.value: Mistral vision-language model for image understanding and multimodal chat
description.note: Narrow baseline description is supported by exact-version image/text inputs, text outputs and conversational API examples; it contains no unsupported benchmark or architectural claim.

patch.notes: AWS documents Pixtral Large 25.02 with a nominal 124B multimodal total (123B decoder plus 1B vision encoder), 128,000-token provider context and Mistral Research License. Active parameters remain undisclosed: Mistral’s explicit 124B active row identifies 2411, with no documented relationship transferring it to 2502. April 8, 2025 is the Bedrock rollout; the revision’s first release, exact weight availability, architecture and dedicated reasoning-mode classification remain unresolved.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains the exact-2502 nominal 124B total from freshly reopened AWS evidence and explicitly patches active_parameters_b to null. Mistral’s 124B active convention is documented for 2411; fresh release/card/legal and later model-team comparison checks found neither an exact 2502 active count nor a named version relationship supporting its transfer. The other 12 field assessments are preserved. No weight shards were requested.
